alerts.title: Iran war live: IRGC says four tankers struck mines in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz mine strikes threaten massive global oil supply disruptions, driving strong risk premiums into crude prices.

alerts.title: Oil Prices Head for Fourth Monthly Gain as Middle East Tensions Escalate
alerts.why: Escalating Middle East tensions, Houthi threats to Saudi infrastructure, and potential post-election U.S. strikes on Iran heavily support four-month high crude prices.

alerts.title: Iran claims four tankers struck mines in Hormuz as strike fears grow after U.S. midterms
alerts.why: Threats and reported attacks in the Strait of Hormuz directly threaten major global crude supply flows, driving significant geopolitical risk premium.

alerts.title: Tanker targeted with hull-mounted explosives in Hormuz
alerts.why: Attack in the Strait of Hormuz using hull explosives raises immediate supply disruption risks for Middle Eastern crude flows.

alerts.title: Tanker Hit by Limpet Mine Attack in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Attack in the Strait of Hormuz directly threatens crucial crude supply chokepoint, driving geopolitical risk premium higher.

alerts.title: Oil rises near 6-mth high as Trump weighs military options against Iran
alerts.why: Geopolitical risk premium surges as potential U.S. military action against Iran threatens key Middle East crude supplies.

alerts.title: Brent Hits $117 as Tanker Catches Fire in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Tanker attack and fire in the critical Strait of Hormuz chokepoint threatens major global crude supply disruptions.

alerts.title: Tanker in Strait of Hormuz Hit by Limpet Mines, Security Sources Say
alerts.why: Attack in Strait of Hormuz directly threatens critical global crude supply chokepoint, driving geopolitical risk premium significantly higher.

alerts.title: Tanker Hit by Limpet Mines in Strait of Hormuz as New Threat to Shipping Emerges

alerts.title: Oil Traders Brace for a Wild Week as Brent Approaches $120
alerts.why: Heightened geopolitical risk in the Strait of Hormuz threatens global supply chains, creating a significant risk premium for Brent crude.

itemsSent.title: Oil prices edge lower as renewed U.S.-Iran peace efforts ease supply fears
itemsSent.why: Renewed U.S.-Iran peace negotiations eased Middle East supply disruption fears, removing geopolitical risk premium and pushing oil prices lower.

itemsSent.title: Greek Containership Sunk by Naval Drones Off Bulgaria as Black Sea Attacks Escalate
itemsSent.why: Escalating Black Sea attacks raise geopolitical risk premiums for European maritime shipping and regional crude supply flows.

itemsSent.title: FUJAIRAH DATA: Oil product stockpiles climb to five-week high, led by light distillates
itemsSent.why: Fujairah light distillate inventories surged 49% to a five-week high, signaling weak regional gasoline and naphtha demand.

itemsSent.title: Houthi forces claim six attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities
itemsSent.why: Houthi attacks on Saudi oil facilities are bullish for crude, but lack of reported damage keeps the impact moderate.

itemsSent.title: Oil majors count the cost of runaway tanker rates
itemsSent.why: High tanker rates squeeze refining margins and increase shipping liabilities, acting as a slight drag on crude demand while supporting product pricing structure.

itemsSent.title: Saudi Arabia reports interception of Houthi drone targeting Mecca
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical escalation in Saudi Arabia raises Middle East supply risk premiums, though the drone was intercepted and damage was avoided.

itemsSent.title: Chevron beats earnings expectations as refining profits soar on high diesel fuel prices
itemsSent.why: Refinery attacks cut crude demand (bearish CL) while surging diesel cracks from outages boost HO (bullish diesel).

itemsSent.title: Chevron and Exxon beat earnings expectations as refining profits soar on high diesel fuel prices
itemsSent.why: Refinery strikes cut crude demand (bearish CL) while boosting diesel prices due to severe shortages (bullish HO).

itemsSent.title: Oil Markets Caught Between Iran War Risks and Emergency SPR Releases
itemsSent.why: SPR releases weigh on crude while geopolitical risks in the Middle East and depleted inventory cushion support prices.
